node.title: Official-rate FPC5 exact-prefilter scale gap
node.closure: symbolic reduction plus independent exhaustive integer replay
node.statement: On every official row n=2^s with 13<=s<=44, the exact FPC5 residual (PF6) is empty for rate 1/4 and 5<=M<=12, rate 1/8 and 7<=M<=28, and rate 1/16 and 15<=M<=56. Hence the unresolved large-source scales begin at M=13,29,57 respectively, while rate half remains M>=5. Exact PF6 parameter survivors at n=8192 and M=13,29,57 prove that the new low-rate cutoffs are sharp for this arithmetic prefilter.
